note: Set A binds more values to the right components and keeps needed conditions (teflon plate with 2 5/16" hole, 28" and 11" plate thicknesses, A36 rod up to 12" elevation difference, footing-detail dimensions 4 3/4", 1'-5 1/4", 2 3/4", C5 scale). Set B leaves three dimensions unbound to any component, duplicates the HSS and bolt claims, and misassigns L3X3X1/4 to the column cap plate when it is a separate angle member. A's notable errors are the PL3-1/2X3-1/2X1 plate (thickness read as 1/2" and 1" read as a length) and a wrong Detail A3 condition on the 2 1/4" threaded rod, which belongs to the footing/pin detail. On balance A is the more faithful and better-bound set despite those misreads.
